snippet.title: SAMSON | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Samson is out April 8, 2026 for $24,99.  

Today we announce SAMSON: A Tyndalston Story! Our brawler set in Tyndalston - a city that never forgives. No gloss, no shortcuts, just a straight shot into the world we’ve been building in silence. Liquid Swords has fought through headwinds, noise and pressure to reach this point. The work never stopped. The vision never bent. This is the result.. 

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634520
Wishlist on Epic Games Store now!: https://store.epicgames.com/p/samson-ab5af7

SAMSON is developed and published by Liquid Swords.
